dTRINITY dLEND was exploited on Ethereum Mainnet on 17 March 2026 through liquidity index manipulation in its cbBTC lending market, enabling an attacker to borrow $257,000 in dUSD against phantom collateral created by flash loan premium dynamics. All bad debt was covered and the contract was paused. A liquidity index inflation bug allowed an attacker to drastically increase the collateral value in the cbBTC reserve by setting totalLiquidity near zero and repeatedly applying flash loan premiums. The vulnerable index update formula lacked a minimum bound and sanity checks, enabling phantom collateral creation.
